description: Redemption Tunic Level 60 Commander Eligor Dawnbringer at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make a Redemption Tunic if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Tunic, 25 Wartorn Plate Scraps, 4 Arcanite Bars and 3 Cured Rugged Hides. Requirements: - Desecrated Tunic - Wartorn Plate Scrap x 25 - Arcanite Bar x 4 - Cured Rugged Hide x 3
name: Redemption Tunic
